book.name: MADIU
book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn MADIU

content: Sises ketin Iasada
Mwurin rahnen Sapado, nin sohrahn en rahnen Santi, Mery mehn Makdala oh Mery teio ahpw sangkalahng kilang sousowo.
A ni ahnsowohte sampah pa rerada; tohnleng en Kaun-o men pwardihdo sang nanleng oh katapwurehsang takaio ni ewen sousowo, oh mwohndiong powe.
Mwomwe inenen lingan, likamwete lingan en lioal, oh eh likou inenen pwetepwet, likamwete sinoh.
Silepe ko inenen salohda kowahlap oh rerrerki ar masepwehkada, re ahpw pwupwudiong nanpwel, likamwete aramas mehla kei.
Tohnlengo ahpw mahsanihong lih ako, “Kumwa dehr masak, pwe I ese me kumwa raparapahki Sises me lohpwuwalahro.
E seuwer ket met; e iasadahr, duwen eh ketin mahsanihong kumwailo. Kumwa keido oh kadehde wasa me e ketin nekinekidi ieo.

Eri met, kumwa mwadangewei kairehki sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, me ‘E iasadasangehr mehla oh e pahn ketilahng Kalili mwohmwail; ih wasao me kumwail pahn kilang ie!’ Kumwa tamatamante me I ndaiong kumwaht.”
Ira eri mwadang pwurala sang nin sousowo, ira saloh ahpw pil pereperen, oh tangatang kolahng kairehki tohnpadahk ko irair wet.
A iet, Sises pa ketin uh mwohra oh mahsanih, “Popohl.” Ira eri keilahng mpe, poaridiong mwowe oh koledi aluweluwe kan oh pwongih.
Sises eri mahsanihong ira, “Kumwa dehr masak, kumwa kohwei kairehki riei ko re en mwesellahng Kalili, pwe ih wasao me se pahn tuhpene ie.”
Kair sang Silepe ko
Nindokon lih ako ara tangatang kolahng rehn tohnpadahk ko, ekei sounpei ko me sinsile sousowo lelohng nan kahnimwo pwe re en kairehki samworo lapalap ako mehkoaros me wiawiher.
Samworo lapalap oh kaun ako ahpw pokonpene pwe re en wie kupwurki dahme pahn wiawi. Irail eri kihong sounpei ko uwen mwohni laud ehu
oh kehkehlingkihong irail, “Kumwail pahn nda me ‘Nah tohnpadahk ko me pwarodo nipwong nindokon at memeir oh kawaisang erekso.’
A ma kepina pahn rongada met, se pahn kadeke oh kumwail sohte pahn perki mehkot.”
Silepe ko eri ale mwohni ko oh wiahda duwen me samworo ko padahkihong irail. Koasoi pwoatet eri lohkseli rehn mehn Suhs ako sang rahno kohdo lel rahnwet.
Sises ketin Pwarohng Sapwellime Tohnpadahk ko
Tohnpadahk ehk emeno eri mwesellahng pohn nahnahn Kalili, wasa Sises mahsanihong irail re en patohla ie.
Ni arail kilangada Sises wasao, re poaridiong oh pwongih; a ekei me peikasal.
Sises eri ketin keiong mparail oh mahsanih, “Manaman koaros en nanleng oh sampah mweimweiongieier.
Kumwail eri kohwei wasa koaros oh padahkihong tohn wehi kan koaros; pwe re en wiahla nei tohnpadahk: papidaisihirailla ni mwaren Sahm oh Sapwellime oh Ngehn Sarawi,
oh kehkehlingkihong irail re en peikiong mehkoaros me I koasoanediong kumwail. Eri, kumwail en ese pwe I pahn ieiang
